summary.text: Sherry Roberts is a Republican state representative who has represented District 29 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 6, 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Roberts was assigned to the House Education Committee, the Health, Education, and Welfare Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
